newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK FIRMER ON MOST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK FIRMER ON MOST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished marginally easier against the U.S. dollar on Friday but was quoted firmer against other hard currencies after a fairly active interbank session, dealers said.

"It was a fairly busy day. The dollar went down to 10.3000/3200 at one point, then we had a client in the market with about U.S.$2 million which some bank probably got and was selling. In a market like ours that amount of money can really get things going," one dealer said.
At Friday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading at 10.2900/3100 against the U.S. dollar, slightly down from Thursday's 10.2850/3050.
On the crosses, it registered gains against pound sterling at 15.9900/16.0100 from 16.0030/0500 and was also firmer on the mark at 6.7800/8100 compared to 6.8020/8210 overnight.
Against the rand, the local unit ended the week at 2.2800/2900, up from 2.2910/3000 on Thursday.
